definitions.explanation: The reason why something happens or exists.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{原因|げんいん}を{調|しら}べている。
examples.english: They're investigating the cause of the accident.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}の{原因|げんいん}は{何|なん}ですか。
examples.english: What is the cause of the illness?

examples.japanese: {火事|かじ}の{原因|げんいん}はまだ{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: The cause of the fire is still unknown.

notes:
{原因|げんいん} means cause or origin - the reason why something happened.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～の{原因|げんいん}: the cause of ~
- {原因|げんいん}を{調|しら}べる: to investigate the cause
- {原因|げんいん}が{分|わ}かる: to find out the cause
- {原因|げんいん}は～だ: the cause is ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事故|じこ}の{原因|げんいん}: cause of an accident
- {病気|びょうき}の{原因|げんいん}: cause of illness
- {火事|かじ}の{原因|げんいん}: cause of a fire
- {問題|もんだい}の{原因|げんいん}: cause of the problem

RELATED WORDS:
- {結果|けっか}: result, outcome (opposite)
- {理由|りゆう}: reason (more personal/intentional)
- {要因|よういん}: factor, contributing cause
